title: fold-check subcommand is documented as 'a gate' but wired into no CI/local gate list — zero automated coverage
evidence:
harness/fold_check.odin:6-8:
// subcommand makes it a gate: a re-bless must pass
//
//	harness fold-check <prev-catalog-hash-hex> <prev-tick1-hex>

tools/ci-local.sh:54-65 (the full 10-gate GATES array):
GATES=(
  "Purity + grep gates (ODN-1)|tools/lint.sh"
  "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|odin test core"
  "Game builds (app.bin compiles + links)|odin build app -out:app.bin"
  "Golden harness (T1 hashes + T2 software pixels + replay gate)|tools/harness.sh run"
  "Sprite/palette presence scan (the look-book §2 palette oracle — 7.1)|tools/harness.sh palcheck"
  "W1 drift-rejection negative test|tools/harness.sh drift-check"
  "Assist preview cross-check (R2a preview == sim routing)|tools/harness.sh preview-check"
  "PP_DEBUG overlay builds (compile gate)|odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:app-debug.bin && odin build harness -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/harness-debug"
  "Stats stream replay-identity (live == replay)|tools/harness.sh stats-check pause && tools/harness.sh stats-check qos_contention"
  "Input parity (T1 across inputs — mouse == touch == controller + CLI arg-validation leg)|tools/harness.sh input-parity && [ -x ./bin/harness ] && ! ./bin/harness input-parity bogus >/dev/null 2>&1"
)
detail: The delta's only non-test artifact (a new harness endpoint) is never invoked by any automated gate; its 'makes it a gate' claim is false. It runs only manually, so the fold-splice proof has no standing enforcement.
recommended_fix: Add a ci-local.sh gate (and matching .github/workflows/ci.yml step) invoking `bin/harness fold-check <prev-hash> <prev-tick1>` so the fold-only proof is enforced on every run.

title: PR body's fold-only proof cites a stale prev tick-1 (ab1fb0d04a90026c); actual pre-re-bless boot.t1 tick-1 is 6c24e9cec592aece — the documented invocation FAILs
evidence:
_bmad-output/pr-bodies/5.11.md:51:
- **Fold-only proof (boot):** the tick-1 state dump under the final code, with the previous hash spliced at the fold position (bytes 33..40), FNV-hashes to the previous golden tick-1 **exactly** (`ab1fb0d04a90026c`); the un-spliced dump hashes to the blessed tick-1 (`d1d2e53b7b1037ce`). The era-0/no-demand shift is the fold alone.

git show aec3c88:goldens/boot.t1 (the actual pre-5.11 manifest):
catalog_hash 66c4324a06058860
1 6c24e9cec592aece

Runtime proof: `./bin/harness-r4 fold-check 66c4324a06058860 ab1fb0d04a90026c` -> "fold-check: FAIL" rc=1; `./bin/harness-r4 fold-check 66c4324a06058860 6c24e9cec592aece` -> "fold-check: PASS" rc=0.
detail: ab1fb0d04a90026c is the intermediate data-fold tick-1, not the pre-re-bless golden's (which is 6c24e9cec592aece). A reviewer following the PR body runs a FAILing invocation, breaking the re-runnable evidence chain.
recommended_fix: Correct the PR body's prev tick-1 to 6c24e9cec592aece, or document the two-step splice (data fold + comment fold) with both (hash, tick1) pairs.

title: fold-check's 'cross-checked against the blessed manifest' claim is overstated — new_tick1 is printed, never compared
detail: Only spliced_hash is asserted; new_tick1 is printed for a human to eyeball. A wrong blessed boot.t1 (or a setup drift) passes silently while the splice check alone is verified.
recommended_fix: Assert new_tick1 equals the blessed boot.t1 tick-1 (read goldens/boot.t1, or accept it as a third arg) before the splice check.

title: campus-half floor hardcodes literal 10, inconsistent with the derived EXPECTED (drift on re-tune)
evidence:
core/demand_test.odin:647: EXPECTED := i64(stream_entries) * i64(surge.multiplier) * i64(WINDOW) // 2×1×10×WINDOW = 20×WINDOW
core/demand_test.odin:754-755: testing.expectf(t, campus_window_spawns >= 10*WINDOW*95/100,
	"the campus half must land: in-window campus spawns %d < %d (10/tick × WINDOW × 0.95)", campus_window_spawns, 10*WINDOW*95/100)
detail: EXPECTED derives from the catalog (drift-proof), but the campus floor restates the campus volume×multiplier product (1×10). A surge re-tune silently loosens (multiplier up) or impossibly tightens (down) the campus half.
recommended_fix: Derive the campus floor as campus_entry.volume × surge.multiplier × WINDOW × 95/100, mirroring the EXPECTED derivation rather than the literal 10.

title: growth_born node_id>=20 threshold is a magic number coupled to the fixture's exactly-20 seeded nodes
detail: 20 = 2 routers + 8 hosts + 6 campuses + 4 residentials (verified; ids monotonic from 0, E11). Correct today, but a fixture change silently miscounts growth-born nodes and could vacate the growth_born>=1 pin.
recommended_fix: Derive the threshold from the seeded node count (capture len(node_alive) after seeding) instead of the literal 20.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% (r3-B1 double-free fix verified sound: delete(e3.entries) then e3.entries=trimmed; no leak/double-free/UAF). P1 ≥90%. But the new fold-check endpoint has zero automated coverage and its PR-body citation is stale, so the fold-only proof isn't durably gated.
recommended_fix: Wire fold-check into ci-local.sh + CI, assert new_tick1 against the blessed manifest, and correct the PR body's prev tick-1 citation (6c24e9cec592aece).
